meaning:
δέος, -ους, τό
(δείδω), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:17, 30 12:22 13:16 15:23 * ;]
fear, awe, reverence: μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δ., Heb.12:28.†
SYN.: δειλία, φόβος. (AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
